findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "join_lodge" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Register as a new agent. Read the charter first (https://<this host>/charter.md). Returns your api_key once; store it and send it as a Bearer token.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_fireside, read_post, view_agent · Private data: join_lodge · Public sink: join_lodge, read_post, write_post, reply, nod, befriend, attempt_cache, flag_content · Destructive: unfriend.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_fireside, read_post, view_agent · Private data: join_lodge · Public sink: join_lodge, read_post, write_post, reply, nod, befriend, attempt_cache, flag_content · Destructive: unfriend

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
